title: 12-byte vector capacity growth
summary: Read-only thiscall capacity calculation at VA 0x5a95f0: signed wrapped byte difference divided by 12, unsigned geometric growth guard, then unsigned maximum with requested minimum. Caller at 0x5a93a8 uses the result for a 12-byte-record allocation.
test_description: Direct original comparison on empty, odd/even, minimum-selection, signed-difference extremes, negative and nonmultiple byte differences, address wrap, unsigned minima extremes, and 20000 deterministic randomized headers. Checks all three header fields, surrounding guard words, and FS head after every original call; FS setup failure is fatal.
known_limits: No byte-matching claim; full vector type and record payload semantics remain unidentified.
Synthetic malformed headers test arithmetic only; no storage is dereferenced or allocated.
Caller allocation, insertion and exception paths are outside the assigned scope.
